summary: Iter20 — SWMS Generator Phase 1 fully verified end-to-end. Backend pytest 19/19 in /app/backend/tests/test_iter20_swms.py (55.88s — suggest-rows hit fallback path in CI, which is EXPECTED per review note; structure still validated). Verified: reference endpoint (20 HRCW, 21 trades, 8 regulators, 6 hierarchy levels, 19 PPE, 18 training), AI suggest-hrcw (electrician+solar returns ['energised_electrical','fall_2m']; electrician+underground returns ['excavation_1_5m','energised_electrical']; unknown trade returns []), AI suggest-rows returns valid {rows,fallback} with proper hierarchy levels, CRUD with SWMS-YYYY-#### reference + version=1 + status=draft + 5y retention + 30d review + audit_log[0]='created' + revisions[0].version=1, PATCH no version bump when draft + bumps when non-draft rows changed, duplicate creates new draft with reset worker signatures + 'duplicated' audit, sign stamps worker with 'awaiting_signatures' until all signed, send-sign-links generates tokens + inserts in_app notification 'swms_sign_links_sent' (Twilio MOCKED), public GET /api/public/swms/sign/{token} bypasses auth correctly and returns trimmed view, public POST signs worker and marks token used (410 on reuse, 404 on unknown), status transitions incl. 'reviewed' setting last_reviewed_at + pushing review_date +365d, link-incident with notifiable=true locks SWMS and DELETE returns 400, soft-archive on first delete + hard remove on second delete (404 after), PDF returns application/pdf with Content-Disposition attachment, starts with %PDF-, >=20KB. Iter19 regression re-run 8/8 passing. Frontend verified live on owner@safetradie.demo via Playwright on REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (https://safe-systems.preview.emergentagent.com): sidebar 'SWMS Library' nav entry OK, /dashboard/swms renders swms-library-page with stat-total/draft/awaiting/in-use + new-swms-btn, /dashboard/swms/new renders swms-generator + swms-legal-notice + swms-preview + all 7 swms-step-0..6 tabs are clickable (step switching works), step 1 fields present (swms-company, swms-work-activity, swms-site-location, swms-site-state default NSW, swms-has-pc), step 2 (swms-trade, swms-activity, swms-workers), step 3 has swms-hrcw-grid with exactly 20 hrcw-* checkboxes + swms-hrcw-suggest, step 4 (swms-rows-ai, swms-rows-add), step 5 swms-compliance-measures present, step 6 (swms-ppe-grid, swms-training-grid), step 7 (swms-signoff-save, swms-signoff-pdf, swms-signoff-sms). Zero console errors during full wizard traversal. Cleanup: TEST_-prefixed SWMS docs and sign tokens.

ui_bugs.issue: swms-company field NOT auto-filled from owner profile on the seeded demo user (business_email auto-filled 'owner@safetradie.demo' but company left blank). Spec says 'company name auto-filled from profile'. Likely either missing users.company_name on owner seed or the prefill source key is mismatched (profile.company vs profile.business_name).

issues: Estimated Start Date uses browser-default <input type='date'> instead of shadcn Calendar picker — inconsistent with rest of app date pickers. Site Type 'Select...' and Estimated Duration 'Select...' appear to use native select elements; rest of shadcn UI uses Radix Select. Consider unifying for visual consistency.
Preview is clean — 'NOT SAVED YET' placeholder state reads well. HRCW grid shows all 20 items with tick-state. Yellow legal notice banner is high-contrast. Hierarchy-colour pills render correctly.

action_items: Investigate step-1 swms-company auto-fill — either ensure owner seed has users.company_name populated (check /api/auth/me or profile endpoint shape) OR update SwmsGenerator prefill to read the correct profile key.
(Nice-to-have) Replace native <input type='date'> in Step 1 Estimated Start Date with shadcn Calendar + Popover for consistency with rest of the app.
critical_code_review_comments: swms_module.py is ~1100 lines in a single file — approaching the 700-line guideline; consider splitting: (a) reference data constants → swms_reference.py, (b) PDF template / render_swms_html → swms_pdf.py, (c) routes stay in swms_module.py. Improves testability and keeps the HTML template isolable.

_call_claude uses asyncio.run inside asyncio.to_thread which works but is brittle — if the outer event loop context changes we could get 'event loop already running'. Prefer await chat.send_message(...) directly if the llm client is async-native, or use asyncio.get_event_loop().run_in_executor. Current fallback path hides any real AI failure behind a generic fallback, which is fine for UX but log the exception for observability (currently silently swallowed in except Exception).

PATCH /api/swms/{id} body-pop of reserved keys (swms_id/user_id/reference/created_at) is correct, but the endpoint accepts arbitrary dict — no pydantic validation on updates. Consider a SwmsUpdate model mirroring SwmsCreate (all Optional) to prevent accidental $set of unknown keys.

sign_swms: when the same worker signs twice (same name), the second sign updates the same record (correct). But ad-hoc sign-on path appends a NEW worker entry even if name matches an existing worker whose worker_id is None — potential duplicate. Add an extra name-match check before appending.

send_sign_links does not check for duplicate outstanding tokens — calling it multiple times generates fresh tokens each call leaving stale tokens in swms_sign_tokens. Consider invalidating prior unused tokens for the same (swms_id, worker) when regenerating, or returning existing ones if still valid.
Public sign token expiry parse silently swallows parse errors (bare except) — if expires_at is malformed it is treated as unexpired. Low risk but tighten to fail-closed.

link_incident sets retention_until += 2y from NOW rather than from the incident occurrence date. Spec says '2 years from incident date'. If the incident_id has an occurred_at, retention should key off that — otherwise late-linked incidents under-retain.

audit_log on PATCH stores only the first 10 keys of the update body as 'detail' — for compliance it would be better to include before/after values (at least for material fields) to satisfy regulator evidence requirements.

PDF endpoint runs WeasyPrint in asyncio.to_thread which is correct, but there's no request-level timeout; a broken HTML in doc could hang. Wrap the write_pdf call in asyncio.wait_for with a sensible cap (e.g. 30s).

Frontend SwmsGenerator: verify step tabs 0..6 indexing is consistent with the 1..7 labels shown to user (found in screenshot '1. Business & Job' through '7. Generate & Sign') — ensure deep-links or step validation errors reference the user-visible index not the 0-based one.

rca_of_the_issue: N/A — Phase 1 works end-to-end per spec. One minor UX miss: swms-company is NOT prefilled from owner profile (see action_items). Reproduction: login as owner, navigate /dashboard/swms/new, observe Company/Business Name empty while Business Email correctly shows 'owner@safetradie.demo'. Mitigation: in SwmsGenerator's profile prefill useEffect, read profile.company_name OR profile.business_name (whichever the /api/auth/me response carries) OR update the owner seed to include company_name='SafeTradie Demo Co'.
